task_description: Implement Phase 3 (the built-in MCP client) per architecture.md Section 5 and tasks.md Phase 3 (P3.1-P3.6): stdio + HTTP/SSE transports, server lifecycle with initialize handshake / capability negotiation / list-tools / on-demand invoke / bounded reconnect-with-backoff / teardown, tool discovery + schema mapping into providers::ToolSpec namespaced by server, the orchestrator-core function-calling bridge, the Ask/Allow/Deny permission model with resolve_permission wiring, and error/resource handling (structured tool-error results, per-tool timeouts, output-size caps, hiding tools from disconnected servers). mcp-client moves from [workspace] members to exclude and gains CI steps on ubuntu+windows; a cross-platform bundled mock MCP server backs the stdio tests. Work on branch phase-3-mcp-client off main. Do NOT implement Phase 4+ (no routing engine / full pipeline / UI surfaces beyond minimal resolve_permission command wiring).

verification.summary: Offline (sandbox, INTEGRATIONS_ONLY): `cargo build --workspace` + `cargo test --workspace` green (offline members only); `cargo fmt --check` clean for mcp-client, orchestrator-core, tauri-app; frontend `prettier --check .` clean. Full build/test/clippy(-D warnings) of the excluded crates (mcp-client, orchestrator-core, tauri-app) is CI-DEFERRED to ubuntu-latest + windows-latest because their crates.io deps (tokio/serde_json/reqwest-rustls-ring/etc.) return HTTP 403 offline; CI steps for mcp-client were added mirroring the providers pattern, ordered before orchestrator-core. No Dockerfile in repo, so docker_build not applicable. test_quality: reviewed the orchestrator-core integration test (tests/tool_loop.rs) and the permission/bridge unit tests. The integration test spawns a REAL cross-platform fixture MCP server over stdio and drives the actual bridge code paths (attach_tools -> visible_tools, resolve_namespaced, validate_arguments, permission gate Allow/Deny/Ask+resolve, handle.invoke, tool-message normalization); it would fail if the bridge/permission logic were reverted. mcp-client's stdio_roundtrip.rs exercises a real spawned child over stdio (handshake/discovery/tools-call/timeout/namespacing/disconnected-hiding). Genuine coverage, not static-assert or fully-mocked.
